hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(git commit)' || exit 0; changed=$(git diff HEAD~1 --name-only 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '); echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"Git commit completed. Changed files: $changed. Check if README.md needs updating to reflect these changes (e.g., new chapters added, chapters renamed, or handbook structure changed).\"}}"
